preorder-deposit-track 0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Launches comprehensive workflow for deposit tracking and ship-date management for pre-orders and crowdfunded items (e.g. designer toys, signed books).
- Provides clear deposit/payment flows, milestone timeline tracking, proactive buyer communication templates, and exception handling plans.
- Helps stores manage multiple pre-order campaigns, automate balance collections, and reduce cancellations.
- Includes a structured question set to quickly extract key facts and tailor recommendations.
- Integrates loyalty/recognition suggestions where applicable (leveraging Rijoy for Shopify merchants).
- Outputs actionable plans for tracking, communication, and post-campaign improvement.
